d:
I wanted this one from Adamyon since a while ago now, especially since Armed Toki is pretty close to arrive. Fill the inside of a strong bunny through her weakest point!
Now the only thing left from them are their Aru doujins, but so far they're physical-exclusive. A pity, but it makes them more worthy.
